sections.col1_bold: Discover the Royal Oak, an icon of watchmaking. Seated around an experiential table, participants delve into the story of this emblematic timepiece through a curated selection of heritage watches and rare archival documents.
sections.col2: Each detail, evolution and source of inspiration is revealed, offering deeper insight into what defines the Royal Oak. The session concludes with an educational activity inspired by its universe, allowing each participant to take home a personal memento of the experience.
